name: simple-trade
description: Crossline (project `simple-trade`) scans Binance USDⓈ-M futures for RSI(14) crosses into oversold (28) or overbought (72) on one configurable timeframe (default 1h). Each signal becomes a limit order at the signal candle's low or high, with a fixed take profit and stop loss. The app follows every order through fill and exit, and keeps a running win rate, fill rate and result in R.
